notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): The HUD durability alert ('armor guy' under the minimap, 8 together-shown body pieces + 3 show-separate weapon/shield/ranged pieces off the UI-Durability-Icons atlas, yellow damaged / red broken) has no MSUI counterpart. MSUI does track durability elsewhere - paper-doll broken tinting (PaperDollUiLaw.IsBroken in Program.CharacterPage.cs), vendor repair (Program.Vendor.Repair.cs), DurabilityTables.cs - but no on-screen alert frame exists.
